spots.label: Chip Drill Hole
spots.text:
Chip Drill Hole

Chip Drill Hole

For mounting data carriers such as RFID chips or ZOLLER »idChips« on ZOLLER Tooling tool holders. The default setting is for mounting on HSK-A hollow shank taper, SK steep taper, and PSC polygonal shank taper.

ZOLLER »idChip«

For unique identification of your tool holders and to ensure maximum product lifespan. Upon request, we can deliver the tool holders balanced and with a fixed chip integrated into them directly to your production facility.

3-Groove Technology

The adhesive in the chip bore of the tool holder guarantees a positive fit for a secure and fixed connection.

spots.label: Four threads
spots.text:
Four threads

Four threads

For subsequently fine balancing of standard shrink fit holders.

spots.label: Long Shrink Fit
spots.text:
Long Shrink Fit

Long shrink fit with an insertion radius

Guarantees maximum shrink forces thanks to the tension applied by the tool along the entire length of the shaft.

spots.label: Feed shoulder
spots.text:
Feed shoulder

Hard-finished clamping shoulder

Garantees optimal sliding of the clamping segments along the clamping shoulder and excellent tension in the spindle. This results in a maximum radial run-out of 10 μm at the clamping shoulder (5 times more accurate than DIN).

spots.label: Concentricity Tolerances
spots.text:
Concentricity Tolerances

Concentricity Tolerances

Tooling Solutions guarantee a radial run-out of < 3 µm.

spots.label: Precision-balanced
spots.text:
Precision-balanced

Precision-balanced

All ZOLLER Tooling tool holders are precision-balanced—G2.5 at 25,000 min⁻¹ or max. residual unbalance ≤ 1 gmm. This results in smooth spindle operation during machining that is gentle on the bearings. You benefit from a longer spindle lifetime, an optimal workpiece surface finish, and longer tool life.

spots.label: Drive Slots
spots.text:
Drive Slots

Hard-finished drive slots

Ensure that the grooves are 100% centered, guarantee a perfect fit in the spindle, and provide excellent torque transmission.

spots.label: Emission area
spots.text:
Emission area

Hard-finished ejection surface

Guarantees a secure release of the HSK tool holder during tool changes.

spots.label: »coolTool«
spots.text:
»coolTool«

»coolTool«

For a perfectly cooled tool cutting edge, optimal chip evacuation, and avoidance of chip buildup on the tool cutting edge. The angled placement of the coolant holes guarantees that your coolant reaches exactly where it’s needed: at your tool cutting edge. This allows you to achieve optimal machining results and extend the tool life.

blocks.header: Tool holder, »idChip« and digital twin – all from one source
blocks.body:
On request we deliver every tool holder fine-balanced with a permanently bonded »idChip« straight to your production. The chip bore is standard on HSK-A hollow taper shanks, SK steep tapers and PSC polygonal taper shanks.

The DataMatrix code makes every holder unique – on the presetter, on »powerShrink« and at the machine. At ZOLLER, measuring, shrinking and balancing are matched to the holders.

More about »idChip«

items.title: Can I order without a ZOLLER customer number?

blocks.body: Yes. Create an account in MYZOLLER and enter your company details at checkout. We check them, set up your customer account – usually on the same working day – and then pass your order on automatically. It becomes binding with our order confirmation.
After signing in you see list prices; as a customer you see the personal terms of your customer account. All prices are net plus VAT.

items.title: Do I need a ZOLLER machine?

blocks.body: No. The tool holders fit every machine with the matching interface. With ZOLLER presetters, shrink-fit and balancing machines you get the most out of them.
The complete geometry and master data of each holder. It comes with your order and goes into ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions or your CAM system with one click.

items.title: Can I order tool holders with »idChip«?

blocks.body: Yes. The chip bore is standard on HSK-A, SK and PSC – simply add the »idChip«, bonded and fine-balanced, to the item in the shop.

items.title: How do I track my order?

blocks.body: In MYZOLLER under “Orders”: order confirmation, delivery date and shipment tracking – live from our system.
